work_item.gloss: a made-up item that no tracker holds
work_item.slice: a fixture, which belongs to no item

summary: The renderer's suite had records of one commit type out of twelve, so nothing checked the sections a `refactor` body carries. A made-up record of type `refactor` now sits among the suite's fixtures, about as small as the lint accepts. No pull request, work item or commit stands behind it.
heads_up: The record is a fixture, and it describes no real change.

rows.failure: A reader takes the record for a real change.
rows.exposed: Anyone who reads the suite's fixtures.
rows.evidence: The summary and the heads-up row both say it is made up.
rows.recovery: Delete the record and its golden files.

changes.text: A made-up record of type `refactor` renders the sections that type's body carries.

not_run: Every gate, because the record describes no change to run one on.

criteria.promise: A small record of type `refactor` renders all seven headings.
criteria.evidence: the heading walk in the renderer's suite
